PROCEDURE populate_goals(pl_cursor_no in varchar2,pl_year_mnth in varchar2) IS

 where goal_custodian in (select territory_id from territory_assignments where
 recruiter_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_rec_id, recruiter_id)) and 
 substr(goal_mmyy,3,4)=:ctrl_blk_1.s_year
 group by goal_mmyy order by goal_mmyy;

Cursor goal_cur2 is select sum(goal_count) tot_goals,goal_mmyy from goals
 where goal_custodian= :ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_id and 
 substr(goal_mmyy,3,4)=:ctrl_blk_1.s_year 
 group by goal_mmyy order by goal_mmyy;

Cursor goal_cur3 is select sum(goal_count) tot_goals, goal_mmyy from goals
 where goal_custodian in (select territory_id from territory_assignments where
 recruiter_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_rec_id, recruiter_id)) and goal_mmyy=pl_year_mnth 
 group by goal_mmyy;

Cursor goal_cur4 is select sum(goal_count) tot_goals, goal_mmyy from goals
 where goal_custodian= :ctrl_blk_1.s_terri_id and goal_mmyy=pl_year_mnth
 group by goal_mmyy;

 Procedure cursor_closing is

 v_row_no:=v_row_no+1;

 ---message(to_char(get_group_row_count(rg_name)));pause;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);

 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));

 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9

 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;

 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
